headline: **MLB Daily Recap: June 24, 2026**
article:
The Chicago Cubs dominated the New York Mets, securing a 10-3 victory with Dansby Swanson's historic performance, hitting two home runs and driving in seven runs. The Miami Marlins took down the Texas Rangers, with John King earning the win, while Otto Lopez led the Marlins' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run, 2-RBI performance.

Several players have been impacted by injuries and availability. Ryan McMahon, third baseman for the New York Yankees, has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a throat infection, effective retroactive to June 22, 2026. Other players on the injured list include Jaden Hill (Colorado Rockies), Ben Brown (Chicago Cubs), Edward Cabrera (Chicago Cubs), Maikel Garcia (Kansas City Royals), Burch Smith (Detroit Tigers), Blas Castaño (Colorado Rockies), and Josh Ekness (Miami Marlins).

The St. Louis Cardinals made a trade on June 23, 2026, sending RHP Chris Roycroft to the Tampa Bay Rays in exchange for a player to be named later. Other trades include the Washington Nationals trading SS Marcus Brown to the Houston Astros for cash, the Houston Astros trading RHP Jayden Murray to the Chicago Cubs for 1B Cameron Sisneros, and the Arizona Diamondbacks trading SS Luis Urías to the Toronto Blue Jays for cash.
